Subject: Altum renewal — initial orderform and scope for term change + capacity uplift

Hi Emily / Tom,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call this morning. As discussed, Altum is planning a term change (move to a 12-month fixed term with an anticipated go-live for extra capacity in July) and a 30% capacity uplift across inference vCPU/GPU units. Attached is the draft order form (Altum_OrderForm_v2.xlsx) and a short summary of the requested term edits.

Ask: can your legal team send redlines on the MSA & Order Form by the end of next week? If you can call out any non-starters up front it will help speed review. Also confirm the correct billing contact for a PO/invoice once we finalize s2s billing.

Attachments: Altum_OrderForm_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

Quick summary of the asks from Altum product/procurement:
- Switch from monthly auto-renew to fixed 12-month term starting 2027-07-01
- Capacity uplift + commitment: +30% for 12 months, with defined overage rates
- SSO/SAML integration timeline: requested by 2027-08-01

I'll loop in our legal and finance on receipt of your redlines.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben —

Appreciate the packet. Our legal team reviewed and I've attached Altum_MSARedline_v3.docx (tracked changes) with the following high-level requests:

1) Data retention and data subject scope: we need explicit language limiting Redwood's retention to operational logs only and stronger customer rights around deletion for regulated workloads.
2) Termination for convenience: Altum requests a 30- to 45-day termination window (we prefer 30) in case of changes in our supplier strategy.
3) Pricing schedule: please clarify how the uplift is billed (flat add vs consumption overage) and include per-unit overage rates in the order form.
4) Audit rights: we need standard SOC2 evidence delivery timeline (30 days after request) — please confirm.
5) SSO timeline: Altum product wants SSO by 2027-07-15, can you confirm?

We're also requesting the MSA include an explicit SLG for data residency for EU workloads (we have a secondary EU footprint later this year).

Attachments: Altum_MSARedline_v3.docx (docx, 76KB - tracked changes)

If Redwood can provide a consolidated counter by May 30 that addresses the retention + termination asks, we can avoid a long redline cycle.

Regards,
Emily Shaw
Senior Counsel, Altum Labs

Karthik / Lauren — forwarding Altum's redlines (attached). Key asks from Altum: tighten data retention language, shorten termination for convenience window to ~30-45 days, and clarify pricing/overage. SSO timeline request (2027-07-15) is aggressive.

Please advise:
- Can we accept a 30/45 day termination for convenience? If we do, what commercial mitigations (cancellation fees, pro-rated refunds) should we request?
- Data retention: can we carve the retention to "operational logs only" and refuse the broader deletion warranty they propose?
- SSO commit: is 2027-07-15 achievable or should we counter with a later date and a defined implementation plan?

Deadline: Altum asked for a consolidated counter by May 30. Can you please send suggested redline language and a short rationale so I can present to the customer?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Altum renewal — initial orderform and scope for term change + capacity uplift

Ben / Lauren —

I've reviewed Altum's tracked changes and proposed the following consolidated counter (high level):

1) Term / Termination: move to a 12-month fixed term with a 60-day termination-for-convenience right (compromise between Altum's 30/45-day ask and our preference). If they exercise termination for convenience within the first 6 months, apply a 50% remaining term cancellation fee (commercial mitigation). After 6 months, provide pro-rata refund for unused prepaid amounts.

2) Data retention: accept a narrow operational logs retention clause limited to system telemetry and request a defined data deletion SLA (30 days) for customer-requested deletions. Carve out regulated data for customer-managed retention controls.

3) Pricing clarity: accept uplift as a committed capacity line item on the order form (annualized). Overage billed monthly at the published overage rate (proposed rate included in my markup).

4) SSO/SAML: we cannot commit to a full enterprise SSO rollout by 2027-07-15. Propose a phased delivery: 2027-07-15 for initial SAML test integration (dev environment) and full production SSO by 2027-09-01. Include rollback/fallback support in case integration reveals blocking issues.

5) SOC2 evidence: we can provide SOC2 Type II report within 30 days of a formal evidence request; operational playbook to be provided as a separate attachment.

I've attached my annotated redline (karthik_annotated_redline.docx) with suggested language. Once we all align on the commercial terms I can produce a clean counter (Redwood_Counter_v1.docx) for signature.

Next steps: Ben, if you can confirm budget owner and billing contact I will finalize language. Lauren, please confirm we are okay with the cancellation fee structure.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: karthik_annotated_redline.docx (docx, 42KB)

Subject: Altum renewal — Redwood consolidated counter and next steps

Emily / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is Redwood_Counter_v1.docx which contains our consolidated counter to the MSA and order form. High-level summary of changes we are proposing:

- Term: 12 months starting 2027-07-01. 60-day termination-for-convenience right with a 50% remaining-term cancellation fee if exercised within first 6 months; pro-rata refund thereafter.
- Data retention: narrow to operational logs + 30-day deletion SLA for customer deletion requests; carve out regulated data.
- Pricing: uplift recorded as a committed line item on the order form; overages billed monthly at the attached overage rate table.
- SSO: phased delivery — test SAML by 2027-07-15, production by 2027-09-01.
- SOC2 evidence: Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II within 30 days of formal request.

If this is acceptable to Altum we can move to signature. I've created a DocuSign envelope for efficiency: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCD1234. Please confirm the signatory and billing contact and we will route for signature today.
